integrator.model: alpha = (3/N)*(G*sin(theta) - K*wrap(theta)*exp(-(theta/falloff)^2)) - c*omega; bottom-contact restitution omega *= 0.15+0.45*overshoot per crossing

integrator.scheme: semi-implicit euler, fixed-step accumulator, render interpolation
